    Star Wars Galactic Racer Achievements Have Leaked

    By Bespin BulletinSeptember 14, 2026 Star Wars Galactic Racer
    Share
    Twitter Facebook Reddit Bluesky Threads WhatsApp Pinterest Copy Link
    Listen to audio version of this article
    Sponsored by
    0:00 / 5:09
    Instaread

    All of Star Wars Galactic Racer‘s trophies/achievements have leaked. We’ll be showing you all of them here.

    Just weeks before the chaotic blockbuster from Fuse Games launches, all of the Steam achievements have been revealed as part of a massive Steam API leak. As per Exophase, there are 49 achievements. That’s just 4 less than Star Wars Zero Company. These are the Steam achievements meaning no gamerscore or trophy rewards are listed yet.

    The list does contain some spoilers but they’re fairly mild/expected. Some require you to make another attempt at the campaign given they are tied to difficulty and one of the difficulty levels is only unlocked after completing the campaign for the first time. You can see the list for yourself below.

    1. Friendly Exhibition Race – Beat any Gold time in Arcade.
    2. Speed is Dangerous, Embrace it Anyway – Gain Surge for 60 s continuously.
    3. The Most Dangerous Racing in the Galaxy – Remain Overcharged for 40 s continuously.
    4. Very Fast, Very Dangerous – Use Afterburner for 60 s continuously.
    5. Hibi’s Speedies – Exceed 650 km/h in any Speeder.
    6. The Real Soul of Racing – Increase 2 Upgrades to maximum level within a single tour.
    7. Punch it, Shade! – Use Ramjet for 60 s continuously.
    8. The Fastest Ever Built – Have 4 Legendary Parts installed simultaneously.
    9. Impeding! – Join the Galactic League.
    10. Qualified! – Become a Qualified racer in the Galactic League.
    11. Disqualified! – Defeat Kestar Bool in the Stadium Showdown.
    12. Let’s Build a Real Racer – Customize a vehicle.
    13. A Few Good Folks – Equip 3 Favors simultaneously.
    14. Inspired by Animals – Gain Hibi’s Favor.
    15. I’ll Take That Bet – Win 10 Sidebets.
    16. That’s How You Win Championships – Place 1st, 2nd, or 3rd in 6 Eliminator Races within a single Campaign tour.
    17. Risk, Reward – Place 1st in an event against other racers without crashing.
    18. Risk, No Reward – Blow up by overheating your Ramjet.
    19. Hunk of Junk – Place 1st in an event with at least 4 Faulty Parts installed.
    20. Start Your Engines! – Successfully complete 4 Pre-Race Checks.
    21. That’s Got to Hurt! – Wreck out of an event.
    22. Now This is Podracing! – Complete the first Tales of Podracing event.
    23. Getting Started – Select a Racer Style.
    24. Raging Rancor – With the Brawler Racer Style, take down 5 racers within a Standard or Eliminator race.
    25. Speed and Violence – With the Tech Expert Racer Style, hit 5 racers with Ion Bolt within a Standard or Eliminator race.
    26. One Hell of a Thrill – With the Redliner Racer Style, stay above 550 km/h for 5 s within a Standard or Eliminator race.
    27. First Time, Big Time – Win your first Rivalry Head-to-Head.
    28. Racing Glory – Complete a Scenario.
    29. Treasures, Treasures! Buy every available Part at the Scrap Dealer within a single visit.
    30. Might as Well – Buy a New Speeder Buy every available Part at Hibi’s Shop within a single visit.
    31. Beginner’s Luck – Win a Sidebet against your current Rival.
    32. Gathii vs. Bool – Win a Sidebet against Kestar Bool.
    33. Star Racer – Have a Backer rate you as Excellent.
    34. Poodoo Racer – Have a Backer rate you as Poor.
    35. Pride of Gathleon – Achieve an Excellent Tour rating from each Backer.
    36. Many Special Treasures – Use every Ability.
    37. Record-Setting Pit Droid Team – Upgrade an Ability to its maximum level.
    38. Four Arms Would Be Useful – Equip 4 Abilities simultaneously.
    39. Big Mystery Racer – Beat 50 Gold times in Arcade.
    40. Maybe We Can All Be Friends Someday! – Gain all Favors.
    41. Clean Sweep – Place 1st, 2nd, or 3rd in all events within a single Campaign tour.
    42. Hail to the Winner, Sebulba – Complete all Tales of Podracing events.
    43. Skill, Strategy, and the Will to Rise – Unlock all Racer Styles.
    44. Best of the Best – Beat every Racer in a Rivalry Head-to-Head.
    45. I Can Fly Anything – Win the Galactic Gauntlet with each speeder type.
    46. Racing Master – Win the Galactic Gauntlet with each Racer Style.
    47. United by a Beautiful Dream – Win the Galactic Gauntlet with each Favor.
    48. Shade! Shade! Shade! – Defeat Kestar Bool in the Galactic League Championship.
    49. Racer of Legend Defeat Kestar Bool in the Galactic League Championship on Champion difficulty.

    Star Wars Galactic Racer will blast onto your console or PC October 6th. You can pre-order the game here. Note: using the pre-order link for the game helps support this website by earning us a small amount of commission. Thank you!

    Has Simon Bird Exited Star Wars Starfighter? Lucasfilm Removes Comedian From Cast List

    By Bespin BulletinSeptember 11, 2026 Star Wars: Starfighter
    Share
    Twitter Facebook Reddit Bluesky Threads WhatsApp Pinterest Copy Link

    There might be an big change to Star Wars Starfighter’s cast. Simon Bird may have seen his role in the Shawn Levy-directed blockbuster significantly lessened or cut entirely. This comes just days after it was announced The Inbetweeners, which Bird is best known for, were making a comeback with a third film now in production.

    The comedian best known as Will from British sitcom was previously listed alongside Ryan Gosling, Matt Smith, Mia Goth, Aaron Pierre, Amy Adams and more whenever Lucasfilm wrote about the upcoming film. However, the company has quietly removed all mentions of Bird as spotted by Twitter user @ThatWeirdoAldo.

    After looking at StarWars.com articles via the Wayback Machine, Bird was removed between August 22nd and September 2nd. Every other word on the post is identical except for the removal of his name. You can see a comparison of the current version of the Star Wars Starfighter cast announcement on the left and the original version on the right.

    Bird’s name was also removed from the D23 film logo reveal around the same time. The most recent Star Wars Starfighter article about the IMAX 70MM release that was published on Tuesday did not include it at all.

    If Bird is no longer in the film, then that’s an interesting twist for multiple reasons. What was his role before? Is he still in the film? Or did Lucasfilm decide they want to keep him out of marketing?

    Additionally, Rey Skywalker herself Daisy Ridley was cast in The Inbetweeners 2. However, Daisy’s scenes were cut from the theatrical sequel. They reshot the scenes without her due to the fact she was filming The Force Awakens in Abu Dhabi at the time.

    We’ll have to wait and see if anyone on either the Lucasfilm or Bird side confirm what is actually going on. Starfighter wrapped up shooting last year and a rough cut of the whole film has been made and watched by cast and crew.

    In other recent news, the Star Wars Starfighter trailer is reportedly coming this December. Learn more here.

    Every Star Wars Game Included In XBOX Disc-to-Digital

    By Bespin BulletinSeptember 11, 2026 Games
    Share
    Twitter Facebook Reddit Bluesky Threads WhatsApp Pinterest Copy Link

    A dozen Star Wars games have been added to the XBOX disc-to-digital program. Fans of recent blockbusters and old school classics will be pleased to find out various titles can be given a free digital entitlement with any disc version.

    For those unaware, XBOX recently launched (only to signed up XBOX Insiders as of now) a system that allows you to put your disc in any XBOX Series X|S or XBOX One console and claim a free digital entitlement. This means you can play the game anywhere you’re signed into without needing a disc.

    For example, XBOX Series S owners who lack a disc drive in their current gen console can play games they own discs for if they put it into another console and they’re signed in on. You only have do to this once. All of this is great news for those still purchasing physical copies of games and/or have a great disc library.

    Publishers need to opt-in meaning not every game is currently supported. Over 1400 games are up for disc-to-digital entitlement right now and many Star Wars games have been added to the program. Hopefully Galactic Racer also joins. You can see the full list of supported games from a galaxy far, far away below via xct.live.

    XBOX Disc-to-Digital List

    • LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens (XBOX One)
    • LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga
    • Star Wars – Episode I: Jedi Power Battles
    • Star Wars: Battlefront
    • Star Wars: Battlefront II
    • Star Wars Bounty Hunter
    • Star Wars: Dark Forces Remaster
    • Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order
    • Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
    • Star Wars: Outlaws
    • Star Wars: Squadrons
    • Star Wars Zero Company

    Some absentees are The Force Unleashed games, MONOPOLY: Star Wars Heroes vs. Villains, Angry Birds Star Wars and more. According to reports, more publishers will be opting in to the program so more games will be coming soon. This list will be updated if any more Star Wars titles are added.
